description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers.
Activate Dimir Aqueductby tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Dimir Aqueduct's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
